scope: Generic service-side evidence rejection fix using immutable saved 9B outputs; no model calls.
safety_properties: Raw model output remains unchanged and traceable.
Only redundant informational observations or a historical duplicate of the same accepted current identity may be ignored.
Unknown evidence, cross-source evidence, dangerous fabrication, unrelated historical facts, and core conflicts still reject the output.
A subject may carry across clauses only for an explicitly enumerated same-subject continuation; catalog-unknown or conflicting subjects are rejected.
Historical context remains attached across a comma unless the next clause has an explicit current-time marker.
